original_test_intent: Verify each GPU's allocated memory usage is appropriate for the declared idle or named workload state.
original_method: Capture UUID/BDF, driver/tool, compute processes and workload/container state; run the exact memory.used CSV query with timestamp and units; retain every device, N/A/error and driver-reserved baseline; compare against the approved condition-specific range without killing processes or freeing allocations.
manual_activity: Workload owner specifies the expected allocation state and range; the agent can inventory processes, collect the metric and compare it.
required_inputs: Expected memory.used range including driver reservation
safety_requirements: Do not terminate clients or reset GPUs
Preserve N/A/errors and no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Normalize documented units and compare supplied range
engineer_actions: Define expected usage by operating state

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field is valid, but a number without process/workload context is not an acceptance result and the transport is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run memory.used with UUID and timestamp plus a read-only process inventory in the same evidence set.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: memory.used CSV and all-visible-GPU scope are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare per-UUID used memory with the declared clients and driver-reserved baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds allocation ownership, units and condition-specific oracle.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Distinguishes legitimate reservations from leaks or unexpected clients.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The value may change between process inventory and metric collection; timestamps must be close and retained.

project_override_considerations: Idle and workload ranges may differ by driver mode, persistence, MIG and service processes; the project policy must name those conditions.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The command and criterion consistently concern allocated GPU memory; expected is an omitted project policy, not conflicting content.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Safe collection is available; missing contextual range delays only the verdict.

review_improvement: Links used-memory values to actual consumers and driver reservation rather than treating any nonzero value as wrong.
independent_technical_reasoning: memory.used measures allocated framebuffer memory, not memory-controller activity. Driver services and active contexts can legitimately reserve memory, so the metric must be correlated with a near-simultaneous process/workload inventory before applying an approved range.
